@spinler@us.ibm.com

Thanks for the comment.

In this example, each device on the PCIe card is intentionally connected to a separate channel of the PCA9548 MUX. This reflects the hardware topology shown in the diagram and configuration, not a slot-level MUX design.

There is only a single MUX in this example; no additional MUX is assumed on the card. I’ve updated the document to clarify this, as other platforms may instead use one MUX channel per PCIe slot.

To make it crystal clear, i would suggest to draw the plug-in card with a box.

It will avoid any guessing as to which chips are on the mainboard and which are on the card itself.

Something like

```
                                                                                        
  i2c1 (Master)                                                                         
                                                                                        
       │                                                                                
       ▼                                                                                
 ┌─────────────┐                                         PCIe card                      
 │             │                                   ┌──────────────────────────────────┬ 
 │Mux (PCA9548)│                                   │                                  │ 
 │             │ ──► channel 0 ──►Connector (J1)───┼┬─> channel-0 (24c02)    at 0x50  │ 
 │             │ ──► channel 1                     │├─> channel-1 (tmp441)   at 0x4c  │ 
 │             │ ...                               │└─> channel-2 (max31725) at 0x2a  │ 
 │             │ ──► channel 7                     │                                  │ 
 │             │                                   │                                  │ 
 │             │                                   └──────────────────────────────────┴ 
 │             │                                                                        
 └─────────────┘                                                                        
                                                                                        
                                                                                        
```

i find ascii diagrams like this easier to look at than text descriptions when it comes to how things are connected to each other.

Is this 'bus+1' actually correct?  I thought mux bus numbers are after all the direct hardware ones?

1.In our DCSCM design, external connected cards (Like Power boards,Fan Boards) conncted via I2C multiplexers and each card includes an EEPROM on one mux channel, which is probed during system initialization.
2.Based on successful EEPROM detection, the corresponding mux channel and its dynamically created I2C bus number are identified, and the remaining downstream devices on other mux channels are instantiated.
3.Since these bus numbers are determined at runtime and are not fixed, Entity-Manager uses relative bus notation ($bus+N) to correctly reference devices behind the mux.
